title: MME-Emotion: A Holistic Evaluation Benchmark for Emotional Intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models
why_it_matters: Large-scale multimodal benchmark for emotion understanding and causal/reasoning capability; evaluates 20 MLLMs.

title: Consensus-Driven Multi-Agent Cognitive Reasoning for Enhancing the Emotional Intelligence of Large Language Models
why_it_matters: MACRo uses specialized agents and structured cognitive reasoning to improve LLM emotional intelligence.

title: PERM: Psychology-grounded Empathetic Reward Modeling for Large Language Models
why_it_matters: Psychology-grounded reward modeling based on Empathy Cycle theory; directly relevant to alignment and RL-based empathy tuning.

title: At Your Own PACE: A Causal Framework for Evaluating EQ in LLMs
why_it_matters: Causal framework for decomposed emotional-intelligence evaluation rather than a single aggregate EQ score.

title: Persona-E²: A Human-Grounded Dataset for Personality-Shaped Emotional Responses to Textual Events
why_it_matters: Human-grounded dataset linking Big Five/MBTI personality to reader-side emotional responses and appraisal shifts.

title: Appraisal Theory-Informed Emotion Prediction
why_it_matters: Tests whether LLMs show human-like appraisal-driven affective reasoning and identifies stability bias in emotion shifts.

title: Disentangling Emotion Understanding and Generation in Large Language Models
why_it_matters: Separates emotion understanding from generation and internal consistency, showing that competence is not monolithic.

title: AEQ-Bench: Measuring Empathy of Omni-Modal Large Models
why_it_matters: Evaluates empathy from audio+text and paralinguistic cues, broadening affective understanding beyond text.

title: Sentient Agent as a Judge: Evaluating Higher-Order Social Cognition in Large Language Models
why_it_matters: Agent-based evaluator simulates emotion trajectories and inner thoughts to assess higher-order social cognition.

title: Who Generates More Empathetic Responses—Humans or LLMs? A Comparative Evaluation with Human and LLM Judges
why_it_matters: Large human study comparing perceived empathy of human and LLM responses across 32 emotions.

title: Emotional intelligence in large language models is fragmented across perception, cognition, and interaction
why_it_matters: FACET uses the Mayer-Salovey-Caruso ability model and argues that LLM emotional intelligence fragments across perception, cognition and interaction.

title: Personalized Emotional Intelligence in Generative AI through Symbolic Affective Reasoning
why_it_matters: Hybrid symbolic/deep framework for understanding and steering personalized emotional responses with human experiments.

title: E^2-LLM: Bridging Neural Signals and Interpretable Affective Analysis
why_it_matters: Connects EEG signals to LLM reasoning via cross-modal alignment and instruction tuning for interpretable affective analysis.
